requirements: R1: Recover the exact code changes originally planned for the Merge Readiness Effa2032 task directly onto the main branch.

slices.title: Recover Merge Readiness Effa2032 patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery for this epic, I want to merge the missing patch, so that the main branch contains the required changes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the missing patch for Effa2032
When the code is merged to main
Then the deliverable is actually present in the repository history
Given the patched main branch
When the system is built
Then no integration or merge conflicts arise.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the count of successfully merged missing deliverables by 1

requirements: R1: Configure the backend Spring Boot server to bind to all available network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of the loopback address.

slices.title: Set server address to 0.0.0.0 in application properties
slices.jtbd: When implementing the network binding fix for this epic, I want to configure Tomcat to listen on all interfaces, so that external container health checks can connect.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend Spring Boot application
When it launches within a Docker container
Then it must bind to 0.0.0.0 on the designated port
Given the running backend container
When a remote health check attempts to connect
Then the connection is successfully established without a Connection Refused error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container health check connection abort rate from 100% to 0%
